REFUND_INFO_TEXT: The refund generation can be done with following rules in mind:
REFUND_INFO1: A. Refund for an order can be generated multiple times. However, refund amount cannot exceed the total order value.
REFUND_INFO2: B. Refunds for orders where payments have not yet been received can only be generated once the Order has been completed/ delivered.
REFUND_INFO3: C. Refunds for orders where online payments have been done can be generated at any point of Order processing.
REFUND_INFO4: D. Incase your store uses wallet and order has a payment thru Wallet & Online mode then refund thru Online mode will be limited to the amount done thru online mode. Rest of the refund can be generated either thru Wallet or Refund Voucher.
